title: Device for the adjustment of a raw-edged lens with respect to an outline pattern of its mount

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
This reference describes an optical system for lens adjustment, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet from a vacuum generating device.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with a sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with a sound-damping material lining a grip portion.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with a sound-reducing device in a housing portion.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with housing portions and air outlets.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with an air collection device or exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit with air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses, not a grip unit as described in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses and attaching a coupling member, but it does not mention a grip unit, a suction plate, or a coupling device for releasably connecting them.

This reference describes a device for adjusting lenses and attaching a coupling member, but it does not mention a grip unit, a suction opening, a suction chamber, or generating a vacuum for lifting an object.

overall.why: The reference describes a device for adjusting lenses using an optical system and an outline pattern, which is unrelated to a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and suction plate.
